description: This PHP class defines a data transfer object (DTO) for filtering Buzz Feed data in the OrangeHRM system. It extends a general FilterParams class and includes properties for authorized user employee number, share ID, and constants for allowed sort fields. The class provides getter and setter methods for its properties and initializes default sorting in its constructor.

classes.name: BuzzFeedFilterParams
classes.description: A DTO class for specifying filtering and sorting options for Buzz Feed data, including authorized employee number and an optional share ID.

methods.name: getAuthUserEmpNumber
methods.description: Returns the employee number of the authenticated user.

methods.name: setAuthUserEmpNumber
methods.description: Sets the employee number of the authenticated user.

methods.name: getShareId
methods.description: Returns the optional ID of a specific share.

methods.name: setShareId
methods.description: Sets the optional ID of a specific share.
